Cost comparison, not a price quote
Gateway: no additional endpoint charge
Interface: endpoint type x selected AZ hours + GB processed
NAT: NAT-AZ hours + GB processed + applicable transfer

span.p:
Gateway: S3/DynamoDB only; route-table association; no on-premises, TGW, or peered-VPC extension
Interface: one ENI per selected AZ; service support, DNS, security group, and endpoint-policy behavior vary by service
Routes choose a path; IAM and service resource policies must also allow access
